_note: Optional overrides for ht-bridge. Every field is optional — defaults live in src/index.ts. Environment variables (HT_CLAUDE_*) take precedence over this file.
_titleNote: Conversation-title sidecar. On UserPromptSubmit the Claude pill shows titleStartingLabel in titleNeutralColor, then a detached `pi -p` invocation generates a 3-5 word title and switches the pill to labelColor. Disable with titleEnabled=false (or HT_CLAUDE_TITLE_ENABLED=0) to keep the original first-clause-of-prompt label. titlePiArgs is the full argv to `titlePiBin` — adjust the model or thinking level here if you want something other than gpt-5-nano.
